name: Wall of Wood
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level druid 4, hunter 4, magus 4, mystic 4, occultist 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4, witchwarper 4; Elemental School wood 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a twig)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect wall of unworked wood whose area is up to one 5-ft. square/level (S)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like wall of stone, though it creates a solid wall of hard wood firmly rooted into the ground. The wood is not smooth but rather has a natural appearance like unworked tree trunks and branches entwined and compressed to completely fill the space; it is therefore as easy to climb as a tree. The wall of wood has hardness 5 and 10 hit points per inch of thickness, and it takes full damage from attacks dealing fire damage. Like a wall of stone, you can create a wall of wood in almost any shape you desire, not just vertical walls (see wall of stone spell).
